# New Employee Onboarding Specification — v1

**Owner:** People Operations
**Last Updated:** 2024-01-15

---

## 1. Overview

This document defines the onboarding process for all new full-time employees. The process
covers the first 90 days of employment.

## 2. Pre-Arrival Checklist

Before the employee's start date, the following must be completed:

- [ ] Send welcome email (3 business days before start)
- [ ] Provision laptop and accessories
- [ ] Create accounts: email, Slack, GitHub, JIRA
- [ ] Assign onboarding buddy
- [ ] Schedule Week 1 meetings

## 3. Week 1 Schedule

| Day | Activity |
|-----|----------|
| Day 1 | Orientation, HR paperwork, office tour |
| Day 2 | IT setup, security training |
| Day 3 | Team introductions, product overview |
| Day 4 | Codebase walkthrough |
| Day 5 | First task assignment |

## 4. Training Requirements

All new employees must complete the following training within **30 days**:

1. Security awareness training (mandatory, 2 hours)
2. Code of conduct review (mandatory, 1 hour)
3. Product overview training (recommended, 3 hours)
4. Development environment setup (technical staff only, 4 hours)

## 5. 30/60/90 Day Milestones

- **Day 30:** Complete all mandatory training; submit first PR
- **Day 60:** Own one feature end-to-end
- **Day 90:** Participate in quarterly planning

## 6. Manager Responsibilities

Managers are responsible for:
- Conducting weekly 1:1s during the first month
- Providing written feedback at Day 30
- Approving access requests within 24 hours

## 7. Resources

- Employee Handbook: `handbook.internal/`
- IT Help Desk: `helpdesk@company.com`
- HR Contact: `hr@company.com`
